From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot for Finlytics — dedicated/VPC option (post-call recap)

Hi Lena —

Great to meet you earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: Finlytics is focused on deploying model-powered document parsing across regulated EU & US customers; low single-digit second latency for user-facing calls is a must, and you flagged on-prem/VPC as the preferred deployment for initial rollout because of data residency and audit requirements.

Suggested path (mutual action plan):
- 2-week dedicated pilot (VPC) hosted in your AWS account or our private region (we covered pros/cons).
- Tech sync: 30-min with your infra lead to confirm network/KMS and data flow (we'll bring Marissa).
- Security: we'll provide SOC2 evidence + a short questionnaire; you can share procurement requirements.
- Procurement: draft SOW and T&Cs, target sign-off in 4–6 weeks if pilot goes well.

Attachments I shared: redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf (pilot options + pricing bands).

As next steps, could you: 1) confirm the primary technical contact for the pilot, and 2) confirm whether you want the pilot in your VPC or our private-hosted VPC? Either way we can stand up an isolated dedicated pool and provide a temporary access plan for the POC.

If it helps, here is my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min

Thanks — happy to adjust the MAP based on what your team needs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf (PDF, 2.3 MB)

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the follow-up and the clear options. We're interested in moving to a dedicated VPC pilot, but before we lock dates procurement and our security lead have a couple of outstanding questions:

- Data residency: For the pilot, can you confirm region residency guarantees and whether logs can be retained in our EU region only?
- KMS: We would like to use our KMS keys (AWS KMS). Can you confirm key usage and any sysadmin access required?
- SOC2 evidence: please send SOC2 Type II report and a short answers doc for our security questionnaire (attached).
- Timeline: procurement is typically a 3–5 week cycle for pilots with standard SOW; we will need the SOW and T&Cs to start review.

I've attached our security questionnaire (Finlytics-Security-Questionnaire.pdf). Please loop in whoever owns SOC2/reporting.

We can aim for a tech sync the week of June 7 — Tue or Wed morning PST works for us.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform Product
